+        sol = least_squares(

+            np.clip(seed, arm_lo + 1e-5, arm_hi - 1e-5),
+            bounds=(arm_lo + 1e-5, arm_hi - 1e-5),
+            max_nfev=200,
+            xtol=1e-10,
+            ftol=1e-10,
+            gtol=1e-10,

+        re = float(np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(target_rot.T @ r).as_rotvec()))
